params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of ids. Matches all of the provided IDs, or returns a 400 error that includes a list of which IDs are invalid.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of a user. Restricts results to those with the specified name.

params.name: nameIncludes
params.description: Name substring of a user. Restricts results to those with names that include the provided substring.

params.name: names.anyOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of names. Maximum of 100. Restricts results to those that match any of the specified names, case insensitive.  Warning - this filter can be non-performant due to case insensitivity.

params.name: names.anyOf.caseSensitive
params.description: Comma-separated list of names. Maximum of 100. Restricts results to those that match any of the specified names, case sensitive.

params.name: modifiedAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the > and < operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. Date ranges can be specified with the following nomenclature > YYYY-MM-DD AND <YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: memberOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of organization and/or team API IDs. Restricts results to users that are members of all given groups.

params.name: adminOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of organization and/or team API IDs. Restricts results to users that are admins of all given groups.

params.name: handles
params.description: Comma-separated list of handles. Restricts results to the users with the specified handles.

params.name: email.anyOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of emails. Maximum of 100. Restricts results to the users with the specified emails.

params.name: passwordLastChangedAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the >, >=, <, <=, operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to users who have last changed their password in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. If "null" is provided returns users that have no password set (SAML).

items.docs:
Returns all users that the caller has permission to view. The following roles have view permission:
  - tenant admins
  - members of the user's organizations

Returns a user by ID if the caller has permission to view. The following roles have view permission:
  - tenant admins
  - members of any of the user's organizations
Returns activity metadata for a specific user by ID. This currently includes lastSeen data.
Returns the list of warehouse credential summaries for this user.
There is currently **no support** for swapping emails or handles between existing users in the same request.
